name: video-to-screenplay
description: Standalone industrial pipeline for reverse-engineering videos and anime episodes into production-standard screenplays with clean workspace isolation, series bible knowledge graphs, and semantic scene clustering. Requires an Aliyun DashScope API key (DASHSCOPE_API_KEY) for Qwen3.8-Omni acoustic speaker diarization.

description_i18n.en: Standalone industrial pipeline for reverse-engineering videos and anime episodes into production-standard screenplays with clean workspace isolation, series bible knowledge graphs, and semantic scene clustering. Requires an Aliyun DashScope API key (DASHSCOPE_API_KEY) for Qwen3.8-Omni acoustic speaker diarization.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 工业级全独立长视频与番剧逆向影视剧本流水线，具备三层沙盒工作区隔离、剧作圣经关系图谱自举、LGSS DP语义场景聚类及标准好莱坞/场号制排版输出。需配置阿里云 DashScope API Key（DASHSCOPE_API_KEY）以启用 Qwen3.8-Omni 声学说话人分离。
